# Pixel Tip Calculator

A tiny offline tip calculator with a pixel-art look. Enter a bill amount, pick a tip percent (10, 15, or 20), set the number of people, and see the tip and total per person.

## Usage

1. Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
2. Type the bill amount.
3. Click a tip percent button (10%, 15%, or 20%).
4. Adjust the number of people (default 1).
5. The tip and total per person update automatically.

All controls are keyboard accessible. Tab to move between fields and buttons; press Enter or Space to select a tip percent.

## Files

- `index.html` – markup and structure
- `style.css` – pixel theme, responsive layout, focus/hover/pressed states
- `script.js` – calculation logic (no inline handlers)
- `README.md` – this file

## Offline & Privacy

No network requests, external assets, imports, packages, or server code. Everything runs locally from these files.

## Acceptance Checklist

- [x] Works from 360px wide
- [x] Tip buttons 10 / 15 / 20 with pressed state
- [x] Tip amount and total per person displayed and announced via live region
- [x] Guard against zero/invalid people and empty bill
- [x] Relative paths and `.html` / `.css` / `.js` / `.md` extensions only
- [x] Visible hover, focus-visible, and pressed states
- [x] No inline event handlers
